## Failure mode
Connection failure: the Enterprise Browser login session expired partway through the run. The AOP has no re-login path, so the Run stopped at the first expired session.

## Where it went wrong
Step 3 of the AOP, the per-supplier portal loop. The Agent signed in to the Agrofert portal as supplier 9 of 17, about 55 minutes after the run started. The AOP treats the browser login as a one-time setup, so it never checks whether the session is still valid before each supplier.

## Evidence
- `[5] Agent: Signing in to portal 9 of 17 (Agrofert).`
- `[7] Tool result ← browser.login: ERROR: browser session expired after 55 minutes`
- AOP Step 3: "For each supplier under 90%, sign in to their portal with **Enterprise Browser** and download open-order status."

The transcript excerpt shows no sign-ins for suppliers 1–8, even though the Agent says it is on portal 9. I can't see how those eight were handled, so check whether their downloads completed.

## Fix
Change Step 3 so every supplier portal is signed in fresh inside the loop. Concretely: "Before each supplier portal, call the browser login. If it fails with a session-expired error, sign in once more. If that also fails, mark that supplier 'portal unavailable', record it, and continue to the next supplier."

This is the only change I'd make. Steps 4 and 5 (drafting and sending emails) were never reached, so re-running the Run should not send duplicate emails to suppliers.

## Next step
I can hand this to `aop-writer` with Build `bld_w02` and the change request above, so it edits Step 3 in `aops/<agent-id>.md`. Before re-running, confirm the Agrofert portal Login still works on its own.
